record.bible_text: Who <FI>is<Fi> as the wise<WH02450> <FI>man<Fi> ? and who knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> the interpretation<WH06592> of a thing<WH01697>? a man's<WH0120> wisdom<WH02451> maketh his face<WH06440> to shine<WH0215><WTH8686>, and the boldness<WH05797> of his face<WH06440> shall be changed<WH08132><WTH8792>. <RF>the boldness: Heb. the strength<Rf>

Where the word<WH01697> of a king<WH04428> <FI>is, there is<Fi> power<WH07983>: and who may say<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, What doest<WH06213><WTH8799> thou?

Whoso keepeth<WH08104><WTH8802> the commandment<WH04687> shall feel<WH03045><WTH8799> no evil<WH07451> thing<WH01697>: and a wise man's<WH02450> heart<WH03820> discerneth<WH03045><WTH8799> both time<WH06256> and judgment<WH04941>. <RF>shall...: Heb. shall know<Rf><CM>
Because to every purpose<WH02656> there is<WH03426> time<WH06256> and judgment<WH04941>, therefore the misery<WH07451> of man<WH0120> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH07227> upon him.
For he knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> not that which shall be: for who can tell<WH05046><WTH8686> him when it shall be? <RF>when...: or, how it shall be?<Rf>

<FI> There is<Fi> no man<WH0120> that hath power<WH07989> over the spirit<WH07307> to retain<WH03607><WTH8800> the spirit<WH07307>; neither <FI>hath he<Fi> power<WH07983> in the day<WH03117> of death<WH04194>: and <FI>there is<Fi> no discharge<WH04917> in <FI>that<Fi> war<WH04421>; neither shall wickedness<WH07562> deliver<WH04422><WTH8762> those that are given<WH01167> to it. <RF>discharge: or, casting off weapons<Rf><CM>

All this have I seen<WH07200><WTH8804>, and applied<WH05414><WTH8800> my heart<WH03820> unto every work<WH04639> that is done<WH06213><WTH8738> under the sun<WH08121>: <FI>there is<Fi> a time<WH06256> wherein one man<WH0120> ruleth<WH07980><WTH8804> over another to his own hurt<WH07451>.

And so<WH03651> I saw<WH07200><WTH8804> the wicked<WH07563> buried<WH06912><WTH8803>, who had come<WH0935><WTH8804> and gone<WH01980><WTH8762> from the place<WH04725> of the holy<WH06918>, and they were forgotten<WH07911><WTH8691> in the city<WH05892> where they had so done<WH06213><WTH8804>: this <FI>is<Fi> also vanity<WH01892>.

Because sentence<WH06599> against an evil<WH07451> work<WH04639> is not executed<WH06213><WTH8738> speedily<WH04120>, therefore the heart<WH03820> of the sons<WH01121> of men<WH0120> is fully set<WH04390><WTH8804> in them to do<WH06213><WTH8800> evil<WH07451>.

Though a sinner<WH02398><WTH8802> do<WH06213><WTH8802> evil<WH07451> an hundred times<WH03967>, and his <FI>days<Fi> be prolonged<WH0748><WTH8688>, yet surely I know<WH03045><WTH8802> that it shall be well<WH02896> with them that fear<WH03373> God<WH0430>, which fear<WH03372><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him:

But it shall not be well<WH02896> with the wicked<WH07563>, neither shall he prolong<WH0748><WTH8686> <FI>his<Fi> days<WH03117>, <FI>which are<Fi> as a shadow<WH06738>; because he feareth<WH03373> not before<WH06440> God<WH0430>.<CM>

There is<WH03426> a vanity<WH01892> which is done<WH06213><WTH8738> upon the earth<WH0776>; that there be just<WH06662> <FI>men<Fi> , unto whom it happeneth<WH05060><WTH8688> according to the work<WH04639> of the wicked<WH07563>; again, there be<WH03426> wicked<WH07563> <FI>men<Fi> , to whom it happeneth<WH05060><WTH8688> according to the work<WH04639> of the righteous<WH06662>: I said<WH0559><WTH8804> that this also<WH01571> <FI>is<Fi> vanity<WH01892>.

Then I commended<WH07623><WTH8765> mirth<WH08057>, because a man<WH0120> hath no better thing<WH02896> under the sun<WH08121>, than to eat<WH0398><WTH8800>, and to drink<WH08354><WTH8800>, and to be merry<WH08055><WTH8800>: for that shall abide<WH03867><WTH8799> with him of his labour<WH05999> the days<WH03117> of his life<WH02416>, which God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8804> him under the sun<WH08121>.

When I applied<WH05414><WTH8804> mine heart<WH03820> to know<WH03045><WTH8800> wisdom<WH02451>, and to see<WH07200><WTH8800> the business<WH06045> that is done<WH06213><WTH8738> upon the earth<WH0776>: (for also <FI>there is that<Fi> neither day<WH03117> nor night<WH03915> seeth<WH07200><WTH8802> sleep<WH08142> with his eyes<WH05869>:)

Then I beheld<WH07200><WTH8804> all the work<WH04639> of God<WH0430>, that a man<WH0120> cannot<WH03201><WTH8799> find out<WH04672><WTH8800> the work<WH04639> that is done<WH06213><WTH8738> under the sun<WH08121>: because<WH0834> though<WH07945> a man<WH0120> labour<WH05998><WTH8799> to seek <FI>it<Fi> out<WH01245><WTH8763>, yet he shall not find<WH04672><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> ; yea further; though a wise<WH02450> <FI>man<Fi> think<WH0559><WTH8799> to know<WH03045><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> , yet shall he not be able<WH03201><WTH8799> to find<WH04672><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> .<CM>
